protocol: skill A/B without technical isolation attestation; no refinement seal
observables: field-only span for direct Dict/raw Content/Float
all other diagnostics and lookup unchanged; prior lookup residual not counted as parity
baseline controls for LocatedContent, other variants, method/callee predispatch
unknown: mandatory Unknown blocks; residuals classify before candidate

roles.root: intent and implementation, may integrate frozen tests mechanically, no test-oracle edits
roles.p1325_tests: fresh-context test author, L0/public contracts/binaries allowed, owner and baseline receipt carrying owner forbidden; writes p1325-ab-* only
roles.p1325_review: independent reviewer, may read product/receipts; writes p1325-review-* only

limits: shared environment without enforced access isolation
budget: at most two no-gain revisions per cause; focal before full corpus
